decisions.decision: Chairman Emond told the applicant's representative that, lacking proof of abutter notification, the Board could not vote on the 58 Spring Street Extension plan, but would examine it anyway.
decisions.quote: the board could not vote on the plan, but would nonetheless examine it.

decisions.decision: All Board members present agreed with the Agent's recommendation for 58 Spring Street Extension: pre-treatment (FAST or Jet type) or, if none is provided, a tight tank; the Presby system does not provide pre-treatment.
decisions.quote: all board members present agreed with this

decisions.decision: Mr. MacKenzie withdrew the request for consideration of the 58 Spring Street Extension plan.
decisions.quote: mr. mackenzie withdrew the request for consideration of this plan.

decisions.decision: The Board agreed that a new water test of the current well at 11 Spring Street Extension, including arsenic and nitrates, is required before it approves the conditional Title V.
decisions.quote: the board agreed that a new water test of the current well to include, but is not limited to, arsenic and nitrates

decisions.decision: For Eagle House Senior Citizens Center septic mound removal, the contractor is to account for all material removed and its ultimate destination, obtain a destruction permit, and take a soil sample (Board in agreement).

Chairman Emond stated that the Town's regulation requires a septic system to be on the property it serves, so shared systems are not possible; each lot would have to prove it can support a fully compliant Title V system, per a phone call with Central Region DEP.
